title: Viewing IaC Alerts Grouped by Scan

blocks.text: The IaC alerts include detailed information about the incident, security policy, and much more. These alerts are also grouped by scan, so you can view details for a specific IaC scan.
To view the IaC alerts grouped by scan:

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, select Alerts.
On the Alerts page, click the IaC Alerts tab.
Click the Alert Grouped By Scan tab.
Click the Scan ID to view:
Scan Details: The repository details, name of the developer who performed the scan, and the date and time when the scan was performed.
Alert Details The alert, policy, and scan details. To learn more, see Alert Attributes.
